item.text:
In my last post, I shared how I was designing a checklist I could use again. I’ve now finished it.

I wanted something I could pick up the next time I do the work, without having to reconstruct the steps from memory. Now I have a checklist to start from and a place to make changes when I notice something missing.

I’m looking forward to seeing what I learn the next time I use it.

**Private review note**  
The receipt confirms the prior post was published and covered the checklist’s design. The supplied evidence confirms completion. The draft leaves the checklist’s contents, prior use, and results unspecified.
